FULL TEXT:
King George Medical University
Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Lucknow
Applications are invited on prescribed format for purely temporary posts on
contractual basis for the project entitled " To study association of heavy metals and
trace elements with ovarian reserve and serum metabolomic profile in women with
infertility -ACross sectional study " under Project Investigator Dr Namrata Kumar,
Additional Professor, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology , KGMU, Lucknow
funded by Department of Health Research , NewDelhi, Appointment shall be made
initially for the period of six months extendable for one year depending upon the
performance of the candidates. Appointment of selected candidates can be
terminated at any time under unsatisfactory performance. Selected candidate
cannot claim for regular appointment and the position willcease to exist when project
iscompleted

Interested candidates with requisite qualification and experience may submit duly

hard copy will be entertained. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email in
advance and required toappear in interview. The interview is scheduled to be held
on 20h of May 2026 at 1 pm in the office of undersigned. No separate call letter will
be dispatched for the interview. No TADA will be admissible for attending interview.
